raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

A same-name `/load_lora_adapter` of a PEFT directory fails with "already loaded", so a trainer that republishes an adapter every step has to unload and reload it. That leaves the name unregistered while in-flight requests drain and deadlocks under a retract pause, which rules it out for fully-async RL. The registry and `LoRAManager` already refresh an adapter in place for streamed weights (`register_lora_adapter`, `apply_streamed_adapter`); this exposes the same thing on the path route.

Miles side: radixark/miles#3690 (http-lora transport). Its tensors mode already streams through the weight-update session and needs nothing here; this is for its path mode (adapter on shared storage, engine loads the directory) under `--fully-async`.

## Modifications

- `LoadLoRAAdapterReqInput.upsert: bool = False`.
- `TokenizerControlMixin.load_lora_adapter`: with `upsert`, resolve `lora_name` through `register_or_reuse` so a held name keeps its `lora_id`, and `refresh` the registry entry only after the backend succeeded. A fresh name loads as before; a plain load of a held name is still rejected.
- `LoRAManager.load_lora_adapter(upsert=)`: a loaded id rereads the PEFT directory and installs it through `_load_lora_adapter_from_tensors(upsert=True)`, so a failed read or install leaves the old weights serving (same rollback as the streamed path).
- `ModelRunner` / `TpModelWorker`: pass-through.
- Cached prefixes are keyed by `lora_id`, so the caller pauses and flushes around the swap, same as for `end_weight_update`; miles under fully-async uses its namespaced radix cache instead. Noted on the field.

Source: 5 files, +68/-12.

## Accuracy Tests

- `test/registered/unit/lora/test_lora_upsert.py`: 6 new cases (manager path upsert incl. failed-read rollback; route-level id reuse, registry untouched on failure, held name still rejected without upsert). 32/32 pass. Also sets `attn_dp_enabled` on the stub manager, which 16 existing cases needed.
- End to end on an H200 with Qwen3-0.6B and two adapters, greedy decoding: fresh load v1, plain reload rejected, upsert v2, upsert v1; each upsert's output matches a fresh load of the same adapter. Same adapters installed through the weight-update session match too.
- Miles RL run on MI300X (`rocm/sgl-dev:miles-rocm10-mi30x`, this patch mounted): Qwen3-4B Megatron LoRA on 2 GPUs, two external engines on 2 GPUs, `train_async.py --fully-async --pause-generation-mode in_place`, http-lora path mode. 7 syncs, every one an in-place upsert under the same `lora_id` with 12 requests in flight per engine, zero unloads, generation never stopped, job succeeded.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: no change on the forward path.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+class TestPathUpsert(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_path_refresh_and_failed_read_preserve_identity(self, _):
+        manager = _make_manager()

+        ):
+            with open(os.path.join(path, "adapter_config.json"), "w") as config:
+                json.dump(dict(CONFIG_DICT, revision="base-model-sha"), config)
+            ref = LoRARef(lora_name="a", lora_path=path)
+            manager.load_lora_adapter_from_tensors(ref, {}, CONFIG_DICT)
+            previous = manager.loras[ref.lora_id]
+            result = manager.load_lora_adapter(ref, upsert=True)
+            self.assertTrue(result.success, result.error_message)
+            self.assertIsNot(manager.loras[ref.lora_id], previous)
+            self.assertIsNone(read.call_args.args[0].revision)
+
+            previous = manager.loras[ref.lora_id]
+            manager._read_adapter_tensors = Mock(side_effect=OSError("failed read"))
+            self.assertFalse(manager.load_lora_adapter(ref, upsert=True).success)
+            self.assertIs(manager.loras[ref.lora_id], previous)

+def _load(registry, *, backend_success=True, pp_size=1):
+    async def communicator(obj):
+        return [LoRAUpdateOutput(success=backend_success, loaded_adapters={})]
+
+    tm = TokenizerControlMixin()
+    tm.__dict__.update(
+        auto_create_handle_loop=lambda: None,
+        lora_update_lock=asyncio.Lock(),
+        pending_lora_unloads={},
+        _pending_lora_publications={},
+        lora_registry=registry,
+        lora_ref_cache={},
+        update_lora_adapter_communicator=communicator,
+    )
+    obj = LoadLoRAAdapterReqInput(lora_name="a", lora_path="/v2", upsert=True)
+    with patch.multiple(
+        "sglang.srt.managers.tokenizer_control_mixin",
+        get_lora=lambda: SimpleNamespace(enable_lora=True, max_loaded_loras=None),
+        get_parallel=lambda: SimpleNamespace(dp_size=1, pp_size=pp_size),
+        get_serving=lambda: SimpleNamespace(tokenizer_worker_num=1),
+    ):
+        return obj, asyncio.run(tm.load_lora_adapter(obj))
+
+
+class TestLoadLoRAAdapterUpsertRoute(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_registry_refresh_follows_backend_success(self):
+        for success in (False, True):
+            with self.subTest(backend_success=success):
+                registry = LoRARegistry()
+                first = LoRARef(lora_name="a", lora_path="/v1")
+                asyncio.run(registry.register(first))
+                obj, result = _load(registry, backend_success=success)
+                self.assertEqual(result.success, success)
+                registered = registry.get_all_adapters()["a"]
+                self.assertEqual(obj.lora_id, first.lora_id)
+                self.assertEqual(registered.lora_path, "/v2" if success else "/v1")
+
+    def test_loaded_upsert_rejects_pipeline_parallelism(self):
+        registry = LoRARegistry()
+        asyncio.run(registry.register(LoRARef(lora_name="a", lora_path="/v1")))
+        _, result = _load(registry, pp_size=2)
+        self.assertFalse(result.success)
+        self.assertIn("pipeline parallelism", result.error_message)
+
